botcomponent.description: List typed key/value outputs and insights from the bpdatavalue table. Filter by _faf001_bpinstanceid_value, and optionally _faf001_bpstepid_value or _faf001_bptaskid_value, or match a key with faf001_datakey eq or contains. Select faf001_datakey, faf001_datatype, faf001_description and the one value column that faf001_datatype names: faf001_valuetext, faf001_valuenumber, faf001_valueboolean, faf001_valuedatetime, or faf001_valuejson. Reviewer verdicts live under keys ending in .decision with free text under .notes.
